mapper.sql: c.*, u.name AS creatorName, u.avatar AS creatorAvatar, r.type AS userRatingType
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.creator = u.id LEFT JOIN ratings r ON r.target = 'COMMENT' AND r.target_id = c.id AND r.creator = #{userId} WHERE c.target = 'POST' AND c.target_id = #{postId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.parent_id = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
